leads.name: St Gregory's baobab planes (two)
leads.reason: Two baobab planes east of St Gregory's church (now Christ Church University music centre), Northgate; a Find a Grave note says new signs said the University no longer permits public access; no current statement. Position is not a fix. Sources: CHAS street-scenes page, KentOnline 2019.

leads.name: Beer Cart Lane / Furley Page baobab plane
leads.reason: Baobab plane behind Furley Page solicitors, St Margaret's Street; on private ground, only glimpsed from the car-park entrance (CHAS, Baobab Planes blog). Not accessible. Approximate position.

leads.name: Cathedral Archdeaconry black mulberry
leads.reason: Ancient black mulberry in the Archdeaconry garden, tradition says descended from the tree where Becket's knights left armour; no measured or dated age (a garden blog says no more than about a century); garden opens only on NGS/special days, so access fails. Source: Canterbury tree strategy 2024-40 mentions an ancient black mulberry; BPT post.

leads.name: Archdeaconry garden yew
leads.reason: Large yew dominating the Archdeaconry garden (visitor blog of NGS opening); private garden with occasional opening; no measurement. Canterbury tree strategy says ancient yews of national significance exist in the district, not located.

blocked.name: St Lawrence Lime, St Lawrence Ground
blocked.reason: Fell in high winds January 2005 (Cricinfo, Kent Cricket, Wikipedia); replacement sapling planted March 2005, left outside the boundary rope; not an old tree. Also ground is a ticketed cricket venue.

blocked.name: Chilham churchyard yew
blocked.reason: Dead: fatally damaged in the Great Storm of 15 October 1987; plaque says it survived 1300 years; only stump remains (Friends of St Mary's Chilham, Alamy plaque caption). Approximate position.
